text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} finds himself heading to a
certain location to watch the first sunrise of the year
alongside Yui, Rei and Hiyori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はユイ、レイ、ヒヨリと初日の出を見るため、
とある場所へ向かおうとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to seeing the
first sunrise of the year together with everyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しみだね、
初日の出。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You've been to the Affinity Plaza before, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン。
愛の広場は行ったことあるよね？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You'd be hard-pressed to find somewhere with a better view
in Landosol, so there's always a big crowd of people there
at this time of the year.
choice_data_list: Are Rei and Hiyori not coming with us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
王都の中でも見晴らしがいい場所だから、
初日の出の時は、
あそこにたくさんの人が集まるんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
They are, but they had to stop by home first.
They said they'll come join us later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも
ちょっと用があるから、
お家に寄って
後から合流するって。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Which is why we're going on ahead first.
We won't be able to get a spot if we're too late.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからわたしたちが先に行って、
場所をとっておかなくちゃいけないの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Okay. The lights are off, and the door's locked.
Yup. We should be good to go now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
明かりは消したし、
鍵も閉めた……
よね。
うん。
準備よし。
じゃあ……行こっか。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I didn't expect such a big crowd at this time.
Thank goodness we came early.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ……
もうこんなに集まってるんだ。
早めに来てよかったね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Are there any good spots left, though?
text_block_list.orig_text:
場所、
あるかな……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
どこどこ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right! Thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントだ。
ありがとう騎士クン！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry about that! I got a bit carried away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
ごめんね！　
つい……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Yup!
There's enough space here for Rei and Hiyori as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
ここならレイちゃんとヒヨリちゃんが来ても大丈夫だよね！
うん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
This isn't good...
Latching onto him like that's got my heart thumping like mad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう……
さっき騎士クンとくっついちゃってから、
ずっとドキドキしてる……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't help that we're just coming off what happened
during New Year's Eve, either...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大晦日にあんなことがあったし、
いつもより意識しちゃってるなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
This should be a happy occasion.
I'm spending New Year's Day with him.
I need to calm down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お正月から騎士クンと一緒にいられて、
うれしいはずなのに……
早く落ち着かなくちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I can't just sit here twiddling my thumbs, though.
I need to make this fun for him! I need a topic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
このままじっとしてるのもよくないよね。
騎士クンが退屈しないよう、
何か話さないと！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I-it's pretty cold, isn't it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さ、
寒いね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Why am I bringing up the weather?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんで普通のことしか言えないの〜！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
So much for having a nice, long conversation with him...
*sob*
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんとした話、
ほとんどできなかったよぉ〜……
ううぅ〜……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I wonder how much longer Rei and Hiyori'll be...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……二人とも、
まだかな……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's already getting pretty bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っあれ！？　
もう空が明るくなってきてる！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: The sun'll rise before they arrive at this rate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これじゃあ二人が来る前に、
初日の出が昇っちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Mr. Knight.
Rei and Hiyori might not get here on time...
choice_data_list: I'm happy enough to see it with you.
I was looking forward to seeing it with you anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね騎士クン。
ヒヨリちゃんとレイちゃん、
間に合わないかも……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
U-um...! Same here!
I'm really, really happy to see it with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
あ、あの！　
わたしも騎士クンと一緒で、
うれしいよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
R-right!
Same here! I was really, really looking forward to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん！
わたしも！　
騎士クンと見られるの、
とっても楽しみだよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
He must have noticed, right?
That I was actually hoping we could all experience this together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
気づいてたのかな？
みんな一緒のほうがよかったんじゃないかって、
わたしが思ったの……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: It's amazing just how kind he is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり騎士クンって、
優しいな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! It's almost time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
見て！　
もうすぐだよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wow...
It's even prettier than I imagined.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ……
綺麗だね……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's getting brighter and brighter.
The scenery ahead is so much clearer now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン見て。
太陽がどんどんまぶしくなってる。
もう少し前のほうが景色もよく見えるよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh. You're not afraid of heights, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
高いところ苦手だった？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Well then. I'll leave this space for you,
so feel free to come over if you feel like it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
ここは空けておくから、
見たくなったらいつでも来てね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why, but it kind of feels like he's watching me as well.
Or not. I'm probably just imagining it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだろう、
わたしも一緒に見られてるみたい。
なんて、
気にしすぎだよね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
He seems pretty pleased, though.
That's a relief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもよかった。
騎士クン、
とっても喜んでくれてる。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
There's all sorts of other scenery like this that I want to see.
Not by myself, but together with you.
choice_data_list: Guess we both feel the same way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日みたいに、
もっといろんな景色を、
騎士クンと見られたらいいな……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Did I let that slip?! Ahhh...
I never realized that you felt the same way, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の、聞こえてた！？　
あぁ……
でも、
騎士クンも
わたしと同じ気持ちなんだ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait. Did I just let that thought slip?!
Do you really feel that way too, though?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
あれ？　
わたし今言っちゃってた！？
……でも、
ホントに？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wow... 
I can't even begin to describe how happy that makes me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うれしいな……
騎士クンも、
同じに思ってくれるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Here's to another great year, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年もよろしくね。
騎士クン。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yui! Mr. Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイちゃーん！　
騎士くーん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That sure sounded like Hiyori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の、
ヒヨリちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Woo, she heard us!
They're over there, Rei! Let's hurry up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞こえた！　
レイさん！　
あっちあっち！
あっちにいるっぽい！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rei's with her!
They both made it on time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイちゃんも一緒だ！
二人とも間に合ってよかった！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness. We get to see this together with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなで一緒に初日の出、
見られるね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Though, well.
I'd be lying if I said I didn't want a bit more alone time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ホントは
あとちょっとだけ、
二人でいたかったな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Let's call out to them, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン。
声を出してヒヨリちゃんたちを呼ぼう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hiyori! Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリちゃーん！　
レイちゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yui and {0} wave the two of them
over together, a big smile on their faces.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしてユイは笑顔で、{0}とともに、
自分たちを探しているヒヨリとレイに向けて手を振った。
